claims.text: [non-obvious] Reframing evals as the ongoing product surface — not a pre-ship gate — shifts ownership from ML checklist to clinician trust design.
A panel speaker argued benchmark leaderboard chasing is misleading for healthcare; task-specific failure modes matter more.
Audience asked who owns eval when PM and ML disagree — panel had no clear answer.
Jordan Lee's team measures ambient scribe quality via physician edit rate rather than BLEU-style scores.
